title: Implement idempotent consolidation worker
description:
Create chatbot/consolidation/worker.py.

Implement a ConsolidationWorker class that orchestrates the three consolidation subsystems (summarizer, contradiction resolver, decay engine) in an idempotent run-scoped loop:
- Import Summarizer from chatbot/consolidation/summarizer.py, ContradictionResolver from chatbot/consolidation/contradiction.py, and MemoryDecayEngine from chatbot/consolidation/decay.py.
- Accept a Provider instance (for LLM calls) and a memory store/session handle through the constructor.
- Provide a single async entry point: async def run_consolidation(session_id: str) -> ConsolidationResult.
- The run_consolidation method must be idempotent and safe to re-run: track a last_consolidation_run timestamp per session and skip if called again within a coalescing window (default 60 seconds).
- Consolidation pipeline order:
  1. Fetch unsummarized memory entries from the memory store.
  2. Run ContradictionResolver.resolve() pairwise across recent entries; apply resolutions.
  3. Run Summarizer.summarize_turn() on new turns and roll up to session/long-term summaries.
  4. Run MemoryDecayEngine.prune() on all entries; persist pruned set.
- Wrap the entire pipeline in a database transaction (using the session's DB connection) so a partial failure rolls back all writes.
- ConsolidationResult should include: summaries_produced (int), contradictions_resolved (int), entries_pruned (int), and run_timestamp.
- Handle the case where no work is needed (no new entries, coalescing window active) by returning an empty ConsolidationResult.
